{{Top|leg}}
'''LOX''' was a substance that was stored in [[pressure tank]]s in the [[Azzameen family]]'s [[Azzameen cargo fields|cargo fields]]. Some time after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[cargo ferry]] [[Raider (cargo ferry)|''Raider'']] attempted to steal a pressure tank containing LOX from the Azzameens, but was stopped by training [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], his sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], and Azzameen [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]].

==Behind the scenes==
Though the exact substance is not clarified in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', "LOX" is a standard abbreviation for liquid [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. Lox could also refer to a [[Wikipedia:Lox|type]] of [[Salt/Legends|salted]] [[Fish/Legends|fish]].
